name: Delta tracking
definition: A Monte Carlo tracking method that simulates photon movement by sampling a free path (distance without collision) instead of directly sampling data. It uses fictitious particles to homogenize density to an upper bound (majorant extinction) to handle heterogeneous volumes.
summary: Delta tracking is an unbiased Monte Carlo method for sampling interactions in heterogeneous volumes by using a uniform majorant extinction coefficient and probabilistically accepting or rejecting null collisions.
